availableAgentCohortContractBoundary.released: derived from the v4 official event manifest after its restricted release-population key and source-identity bridge is verified
availableAgentCohortContractBoundary.generator: derived without reading v4 records, from v5 actual generated event/ego keys under the pinned fixed four-agent mini materialization contract
availableAgentCohortContractBoundary.limitation: v5 retains generated keys and restricted population summaries, not the per-row cooperator arrays; this is available-agent contract replay, not actual generated-cooperator, row-payload, or annotation equality

canonicalContracts.ordering: ascending UTF-16 code-unit order of canonical split/scenario/timestamp/ego keys
canonicalContracts.uniqueness: exactly one record per canonical key

metainfoNormalization.boundary: The raw mismatch remains recorded as a failed equality observation. This exact alias is accepted only under the two pinned artifact hashes and exact OPV2V/CooperScene label pair; all other raw metainfo fields remain exact and mutations fail closed.

mandatoryGate.rule: pass only when canonical record set, available-agent cohort contract manifest, canonical metainfo after the explicit pinned alias, and bound identity are all equal

provenance.derivation: v4 restricted-parser population/key bridge plus its independently bound official event/cohort manifest; no v5 generated keys read

availableAgentCohortContractDerivation.source: v4 independently bound official event manifest
availableAgentCohortContractDerivation.rule: all event agents except the current ego

provenance.derivation: v5 actual fixed-converter execution generatedKeys plus its restricted generated-index inspection; no v4 released records read

fullReleasedPopulationProbe.exitSemantics: runMandatoryGate throws PreflightError and the CLI exits non-zero

supported: For the pinned mini test evidence, the actually executed fixed public converter reproduces the 30-event, 90-record vehicle-ego key set. The two independently derived available-agent cohort contracts, explicitly aliased canonical metainfo, split, and bound identities also match.
The complete released 120-record population is not equal to the current 90-record generator population; each of the 30 events has one released-only ego-0 record.
unsupported: No AP, benchmark metric, model output, ranking, paper result, or performance direction is read or inferred.
No historical generator for the released pickle is identified.
No full-release population consistency is claimed.
No equality of actual per-row generated cooperatorAgentIds is claimed; v5 did not persist those rows or a cooperator manifest.
No raw metainfo equality is claimed; the pinned raw dataset labels are OPV2V and CooperScene and are explicitly unequal.
No annotation, bounding-box, point-cloud, image, or byte-for-byte pickle parity is claimed.

actualGeneratedCooperatorManifestParity.reason: The v5 restricted parser extracted cooperatorAgentIds while the temporary generated pickle existed, but restrictedGeneratedIndexInspection did not persist row-level cooperator IDs or a cooperator manifest, and the temporary generated pickle was removed.
actualGeneratedCooperatorManifestParity.requiredEvidence: A new independent fixed-converter execution that persists a content-addressed generated cooperator manifest without sourcing cooperators from the released projection.
actualGeneratedCooperatorManifestParity.prohibitedInference: availableAgentCohortContractIds must not be described as actual generated cooperators.

integrityBoundary.mechanism: SHA-256 content address over every certificate field except certificateSha256 itself
integrityBoundary.statement: This is a local integrity proof for pinned evidence and canonical manifests. It is not an author, publisher, dataset-owner, or official identity signature.

reproducibility.outputContract: passing scope emits certificate JSON; any mismatch emits a structured PreflightError JSON witness on stderr and exits non-zero
